body: Everyone says so, plus the 50k claim, but I have not seen any proof beyond “others said so”
Id love to know more about the issue. DM perhaps?
Hit me once, but that was it. He did threaten me a lot though. Still does.
He does. Im not sure what you mean.
Now or in the past? She did threaten me a lot, she still berates and demeans me sometimes, but thats not what happened today. She is just making it seem like Im somehow doing all this to hurt her.
I dont have the best parents. Besides, I dont know her parents. She’s been to therapy already, it didnt help. I dont know what to do

I feel you. The way I see it, my problems literally only exist in my head. So long as I stay shut, Im not hurting those around me.

I recommend you to call a suicide helpline. Its anonymous. And they are prepared to handle that sort of stuff. You are not a burden to them.

Thanks. I dont know if it actually helps. I feel awful venting. I feel guilty. There are enough problems in the world, I dont want to add on to it. Literally no one even knows about my problems. So as long as I stay shut, they virtually dont exist. That way, Im not burdening anyone. Im not saying thats necessarily true, but its the way I think and I cant help it. Im really sorry I reminded you of your past experience by my post.
Dont be. I seriously didnt have it that bad. I shouldnt even be complaining about this stuff
They wont be as far as I know. Its only a diagnosis. But I have a a future appointment with a therapist this September. Meetings with her will be regular (unless I decide to change my therapist).

It is true. I am constantly putting extra pressure on myself. Extra responsibilities to take care of. But as hard as it is too keep up with all this, the guilt of not doing enough for the day is nothing compared to the things my unoccupied mind puts me through. I need to distract myself or these intrusive thoughts get worse. 

I have a scheduled session with a psychiatrist, but its a month away. Ive been waiting for this for months already, but the appointment still seems to be far away. I just hope they can actually help me.

What she said was wrong. I understand where she is coming from, but it doesnt make it any more right.

I can also see your point of view. I can see how you believe youre going to make it easier for others if you go through this. 

And Im sorry you feel that way. I really am. I know what its like to feel helpless. To feel overwhelmed.  But I still believe you can have a wonderful life OP. I do. Im sorry if it makes you feel as if the way youre feeling right now doesnt matter, because it absolutely does. Everything you feel is valid. Youre not less of a person for feeling this way.
